translate_en|mods/ExtensiveHealthReworkB: Fungal lung infection from prolonged exposure to decaying corpses in damp environments. Progressive respiratory failure.
Random chance per tick. Lower = more frequent. 50 = 1 in 50 chance.
Allow character to black out from critical blood loss.
How fast blood drains from wounds. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.

Hours without bleeding before regeneration begins. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Timer resets every time you start bleeding again <LINE> - Simulates your body stabilizing before producing new blood <LINE> - Lower values = faster recovery start <LINE> - Higher values = more realistic (body needs time to recover) <LINE> <LINE> RECOMMENDED: 2.0 hours (default) for balanced gameplay.

Allow natural blood regeneration over time. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Your body regenerates blood naturally when bleeding has stopped <LINE> - Regeneration only begins after a delay period (no active bleeding) <LINE> - Regeneration ONLY works if blood is above the minimum threshold <LINE> - Being fed, hydrated, and rested speeds up regeneration <LINE> <LINE> IMPORTANT: Transfusions are still the fastest way to restore blood in emergencies!

Minimum blood percentage required for regeneration to work. <LINE> <LINE> HOW IT WORKS: <LINE> - Below this threshold, your body is too weak to regenerate <LINE> - You MUST use blood transfusions to get above this level <LINE> - Simulates critical blood loss requiring medical intervention <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLE (30% default, 5000 mL max): <LINE> - Below 1500 mL = NO natural regeneration <LINE> - Need transfusion to reach 1500+ mL first <LINE> <LINE> Lower = more forgiving, Higher = more realistic/hardcore.

Milliliters of blood regenerated per in-game hour. <LINE> <LINE> REFERENCE (5000 mL max blood): <LINE> - 50 mL/hr (default) = ~70 hours to fully recover from critical <LINE> - 100 mL/hr = ~35 hours to fully recover <LINE> - 200 mL/hr = ~17 hours (arcade mode) <LINE> <LINE> Real human regeneration is ~40-50 mL/hour. <LINE> Being well-fed and hydrated provides a 50% bonus!
Blood percentage above which character is considered healthy.
Blood percentage for mild blood loss effects.
Blood percentage for moderate blood loss. Below this is CRITICAL.

Enables custom body temperature tracking with gradual effects. <LINE> <LINE> FEATURES: <LINE> - Tracks body temperature in Celsius (37C = normal) <LINE> - Gradual cooling/warming based on environment <LINE> - Pre-disease effects (shivering, sweating) <LINE> - Smooth transition to hypothermia/heat exhaustion <LINE> <LINE> When disabled: <LINE> - Falls back to exposure-time-based disease triggering <LINE> - Vanilla temperature system is NOT suppressed <LINE> - Allows other temperature mods to work (e.g. Realistic Temps)
Cold weather + wet exposure can cause common cold. Can progress to pneumonia.
How fast corpse sickness progresses. 1.0 = normal.
Enable EHR Debug Menu access (press G). Also enables console logging. Does NOT require Steam -debug flag. In multiplayer, admin privileges are also required.
How often your character speaks about injuries, diseases, and other health events.
Enable food poisoning and other diseases.
How fast diseases progress. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
Drinking contaminated water can cause dysentery. LETHAL through dehydration.
How fast environmental diseases (cold, hypothermia, dysentery) progress. 1.0 = normal.
Award First Aid skill XP for medical actions like taking medication, treating diseases, blood transfusions, and self-examination.

Multiplier for First Aid XP gained from EHR medical actions. <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLES: <LINE> - 0.0 = No XP (disabled) <LINE> - 0.5 = Half XP <LINE> - 1.0 = Normal XP (default) <LINE> - 2.0 = Double XP <LINE> - 5.0 = 5x XP (fast learning) <LINE> <LINE> BASE XP VALUES: <LINE> - Take medication: 1-6 XP (based on tier) <LINE> - Correct treatment: 3 XP <LINE> - Cure disease: 20 XP <LINE> - Blood transfusion: 10 XP <LINE> - Self-examination: 1-5 XP
Rotten, raw, or burned food causes food poisoning. Nausea, vomiting, dehydration. Survivable with proper hydration.
Stomach bug from eating with dirty/bloody hands. Causes vomiting and dehydration. Wash your hands!
Body parts only heal when not stressed.
Body parts only heal when not hungry.
Body parts only heal when not thirsty.
Body parts only heal when not in significant pain.
Body parts only heal when not exhausted.
Hot weather + exertion + dehydration causes heat exhaustion. Can progress to LETHAL heat stroke. Get shade and water!
Extreme cold + wet exposure causes hypothermia. LETHAL - cardiac arrest risk.

Allow Knox Virus Cure items to spawn in the world. <LINE> <LINE> ITEMS AFFECTED: <LINE> - Phalanx Pills (slows infection) <LINE> - Antibody Test Kit (detects infection stage) <LINE> - Immunobooster Shot (boosts resistance) <LINE> - Gene Therapy Kit (cures Knox Virus) <LINE> <LINE> These ultra-rare items only spawn in the Military Research Facility basement near Rosewood. <LINE> <LINE> Disable this if you want a more vanilla zombie experience with NO cure possibility.
Wrong self-diagnosis can lead to ineffective treatment. Higher First Aid skill = better accuracy.
Enable integration with N&C's Narcotics mod (requires mod to be loaded).
Infection progression multiplier when on opioids. 0.5 = 50% slower infection.
Drug overdose triggers EHR disease system.
Blood loss multiplier when on stimulants (cocaine, meth). 1.5 = 50% more blood loss.
Minimum seconds between pain vocalizations. 300 = 5 minutes.
Character vocalizes pain when injured. Pain sounds attract zombies!
Untreated cold can become pneumonia. LETHAL without antibiotics. Coughing attracts zombies!

Enable warning effects before diseases contract. <LINE> <LINE> EFFECTS: <LINE> - Shivering and dialogue when cold <LINE> - Sweating and dialogue when hot <LINE> - Movement penalties at extreme temps <LINE> - Increased fatigue/thirst drain <LINE> <LINE> Provides warning before hypothermia/heat exhaustion.
H2S gas poisoning from corpses in enclosed spaces. Causes olfactory fatigue (stop smelling = DANGER). Can knock you unconscious!
How fast sepsis progresses. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.

How quickly body temperature changes. <LINE> <LINE> EXAMPLES: <LINE> - 0.25 = Very slow (4x longer to change) <LINE> - 1.0 = Normal speed (default) <LINE> - 2.0 = Fast (2x quicker changes) <LINE> - 4.0 = Very fast (arcade mode)
LETHAL lockjaw from rusty/dirty deep wounds. Long incubation (3-7 days), then spasms, can't eat, death. Rare antitoxin required to survive.
Parasitic worm infection from raw/undercooked wild game (rats, boar, bear). SEVERE muscle pain, can be lethal. Cook your meat!
CHRONIC disease from long-term corpse exposure. Takes weeks/months to contract. LETHAL without sustained antibiotic treatment (21+ days). Bloody cough, weight loss.
How fast infections progress. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast.
How far zombies can hear pain sounds. Higher = more dangerous.
Medical-grade activated charcoal. <LINE> Absorbs toxins - CURES food poisoning and corpse sickness. <LINE> Treatment time: 24 hours.
Injectable Albendazole antiparasitic. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe parasitic infections (72hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Abdominal Pain, Dizziness
Anti-diarrheal tablets. <LINE> Stops diarrhea from dysentery or food poisoning. <LINE> 50% symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory pills. <LINE> Reduces swelling and pain from infections. <LINE> 40% inflammation reduction. Does NOT cure.
Anti-nausea medication. <LINE> Reduces nausea and vomiting from food poisoning or corpse sickness. <LINE> 50% symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Prescription antibiotic ointment. <LINE> CURES skin infections (wounds, cellulitis). <LINE> Topical application. Treatment time: 72 hours.

Blood compatibility test for Gene Therapy. <LINE> Tests your survival odds before using <LINE> the Gene Therapy Injector. <LINE> <LINE> Results based on blood type: <LINE> - High Compatibility (75%+) <LINE> - Moderate Compatibility (50-74%) <LINE> - Low Compatibility (25-49%) <LINE> - Critical Risk (<25%) <LINE> <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
Oral antifungal medication. <LINE> CURES corpse sickness. <LINE> Treatment time: 5 days.
Antiparasitic medication. <LINE> CURES parasitic infections (trichinosis). <LINE> Treatment time: 7 days.
Topical antiseptic cream. <LINE> Apply to wounds to prevent infection. <LINE> 25% infection reduction. Does NOT cure established infections.
Prescription antiviral medication. <LINE> CURES viral infections (cold, gastroenteritis). <LINE> Treatment time: 48 hours.
Blood bag containing AB- blood. <LINE> Compatible with: AB-, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.

Blood bag containing AB+ blood (Universal Recipient). <LINE> Can only be given to AB+. <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Blood bag containing A- blood. <LINE> Compatible with: A-, A+, AB-, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Blood bag containing A+ blood. <LINE> Compatible with: A+, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Blood bag containing B- blood. <LINE> Compatible with: B-, B+, AB-, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Blood bag containing B+ blood. <LINE> Compatible with: B+, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.

Blood bag containing O- blood (Universal Donor). <LINE> Can be given to any blood type. <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Blood bag containing O+ blood. <LINE> Compatible with: O+, A+, B+, AB+ <LINE> Restores 500mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> PERISHABLE: Keep refrigerated! Spoils quickly at room temp.
Broad spectrum antibiotic pills. <LINE> CURES multiple bacterial infections including sepsis. <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours.
Inhaler for respiratory distress. <LINE> Opens airways - helps with pneumonia and corpse sickness. <LINE> 45% breathing improvement. Does NOT cure.
Chelation therapy kit for heavy metal poisoning. <LINE> FAST CURE for corpse sickness (48hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Headache, Fatigue, Nausea
Over-the-counter cold and flu relief. <LINE> Reduces fever, fatigue, and minor pain. <LINE> Does NOT cure - symptom relief only (40%).
Hospital-grade corticosteroid injection. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe inflammation (24hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Immunosuppression, Insomnia
Cough suppressant tablets. <LINE> Reduces urge to cough - avoid attracting zombies! <LINE> 45% cough reduction. Does NOT cure.
Liquid cough medicine. <LINE> Suppresses cough reflex - good for stealth! <LINE> Reduces coughing by 50%. Does NOT cure.
Electrolyte replacement powder - mix with water. <LINE> Treats dehydration from dysentery, heat, or vomiting. <LINE> 40% symptom relief. Does NOT cure.
Emergency sepsis treatment kit. <LINE> FASTEST CURE for sepsis (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Severe Fatigue, Nausea, Fever

Empty sterile blood collection bag. <LINE> Can be used to draw and store your own blood. <LINE> Requires 80%+ blood volume to donate safely. <LINE> Creates a blood bag matching your blood type. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> Store filled bags refrigerated!
Emergency epinephrine auto-injector. <LINE> Treats severe allergic reactions and cardiac arrest. <LINE> Can revive unconscious patients.

Experimental gene therapy for Knox Virus. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.3,0.3> EXTREMELY RARE - Military research item <LINE> <LINE> Success depends on blood type compatibility: <LINE> O-: 95% | O+: 85% | A-/B-: 75% <LINE> A+/B+: 65% | AB-: 50% | AB+: 40% <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:0,1,0> SUCCESS: Permanent immunity <LINE> <RGB:1,0,0> FAILURE: Instant death <LINE> <LINE> Use Antibody Test first to check compatibility!
IV Amphotericin B - powerful antifungal. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe corpse sickness (48hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Fever, Kidney Stress, Fatigue
Intravenous antibiotic solution. <LINE> FAST CURE for severe infections (36hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Nausea, Fatigue
IV Ciprofloxacin fluoroquinolone antibiotic. <LINE> FAST CURE for GI infections (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Tendon Weakness, Dizziness
Complete IV administration kit with tubing, needles, and connectors. <LINE> Required for administering IV medications. <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
IV Metronidazole for anaerobic bacteria. <LINE> FAST CURE for dysentery and sepsis (24hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Metallic Taste, Nausea
IV Vancomycin - last resort antibiotic. <LINE> FAST CURE for resistant infections (48hrs). <LINE> Requires IV Kit. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Red Man Syndrome, Kidney Stress

Pre-exposure Knox Virus prophylaxis. <LINE> <RGB:0,1,0> Grants 24 hours of immunity <LINE> <LINE> Must be taken BEFORE getting bitten! <LINE> Does NOT help if already infected. <LINE> <LINE> 7-day cooldown between uses. <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS (while active): <LINE> Mild nausea, Reduced stamina regen, <LINE> Occasional tremors
Over-the-counter muscle relaxants. <LINE> Eases muscle spasms from tetanus or parasites. <LINE> 40% spasm reduction. Does NOT cure.
Medical rehydration solution kit. <LINE> CURES dehydration-based conditions (dysentery, heat exhaustion). <LINE> Treatment time: 48 hours.

Knox Virus suppressant medication. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> DOES NOT CURE - Resets infection progress <LINE> <LINE> Diminishing returns with each use: <LINE> 1st: Full reset | 2nd: Reset to 25% <LINE> 3rd: Reset to 50% | 4th: Reset to 75% <LINE> 5th+: No effect (body adapted) <LINE> <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: <LINE> Extreme nausea (6h), Fever (12h), <LINE> Weakened immunity (48h)
Strong prescription antibiotics. <LINE> CURES bacterial infections (wounds, cellulitis, pneumonia). <LINE> Treatment time: 72 hours.
Rifampicin combination therapy for TB. <LINE> FAST CURE for tuberculosis (14 days vs 21). <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Orange Urine, Liver Stress, Fatigue
Sterile saline IV bag. <LINE> No blood type matching required. <LINE> Restores 250mL blood volume. <LINE> <RGB:0.7,0.7,0.7> Long shelf life, but keep sealed.
Sterile disposable syringe. <LINE> Required for injectable medications. <LINE> Single use - consumed on use.
Isoniazid - first-line TB treatment. <LINE> CURES tuberculosis with prolonged treatment. <LINE> Treatment time: 21 days (TB is chronic).
Tetanus antitoxin injection. <LINE> Neutralizes tetanus toxin - CURES tetanus. <LINE> Requires syringe. Treatment time: 5 days.
Tetanus immunoglobulin - immediate protection. <LINE> FAST CURE for tetanus (48hrs). <LINE> Requires syringe. <LINE> <RGB:1,0.5,0> SIDE EFFECTS: Injection Pain, Fever
